entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, security-dashboard-uat-followup-fixes/spec.md, and security-dashboard-uat-remediation-review/disposition.md. Confirmed four findings in scope (Blockers #2/#11, Minors #14/#49) and 1-session plan.

Baseline Playwright on master: 120/3/1. 3 deterministic failures (DefaultMasks_AddPhoneMask, ColumnRestrictions_AddButton_EnabledForFreshPair, E2E_WF_05_AddsProductAfterKeyboardAndValidationChecks) appear to be config-state pollution, not scope regressions.

Added roles-override path to dev-quick-signin (dev-quick-signin.js accepts optional roles; DevPersona record carries RolesOverride; QuickSignInDialog + Login dropdowns send override when present). New persona: Jordan Ellis — User (baked-in role override, Role Documentation only) uses jdoe@ email with roles=User override. No DB seed change needed.

OrganizationMasterDetailsTab.OnPersistedAsync now auto-re-expands the results shell and clears summary text after persist, so the newly-created row is visible without the human needing a shell-header click. Existing Playwright test updated to drop the redundant shell-header click.

Pinned en-US culture in both AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web and AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api via CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture + Web app.UseRequestLocalization. Fixes the POSIX-locale InvariantCulture fallback that made currency render as ¤ in Docker.

Switched RoleMasterGrid, OrganizationMasterGrid, UsersMasterGrid from SelectedItemChanged+SelectedItem to RowClick+ReadOnly. RowClick fires on every row click regardless of SelectedItem state so first-column cell clicks collapse the shell on first click; ReadOnly prevents MudDataGrid from interpreting the click as a cell-edit intent.

Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/SecurityDashboardUatFollowupCoverageTests.cs with four tests, one per finding: SecurityNav_BakedInUserPersona_NavVisible_RoleDocOnlyAsync; OrgMasterDetails_CreateOrganization_AutoReexpandsShellAsync; Products_BackofficeUser_UnitPriceColumn_ShowsDollarSymbolAsync; RoleMasterGrid_FirstColumnCellClick_CollapsesShellOnFirstClickAsync. Also updated the existing OrgMasterDetails_CreateOrganization_GridRefreshesInCircuitAsync to match the new auto-re-expand behaviour.

dotnet test --filter !Playwright = 661/0 (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Security 280, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 185, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 27, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 123). Confirms culture-pin + RowClick refactor + dev-persona reshape do not break any unit/integration/bUnit coverage.

Hand-authored UAT checklist security-dashboard-uat-followup-fixes-uat-checklist.json covering all 4 findings (Shell/Access baked-in User nav; Org in-circuit refresh auto-re-expand; Data-bound /products currency; Master-Details row-select single-click). Each item carries TestData and E2ETestReference to the matching method in SecurityDashboardUatFollowupCoverageTests.cs.

route(task_type=uat-coverage-review) reached VERIFIED after 5 rounds. Iterations added explicit drawer-visibility assertion, shell-summary text check (ToHaveTextAsync), grid-scoped row locators, .mud-table-head currency header assertion, and role-details-section visibility. Generator: opus (total ~$2.64). Verifier: gpt-5-4 (total ~$0.49). Round 5 both VERIFIED.

Full Playwright suite on rebuilt Docker web+api: 127/0/1 green (1 pre-existing Skip, MultiOrganization E2E_WF_02). The three pre-existing suite-pollution failures from the baseline all cleared with the container rebuild.

route(task_type=session-verification) → opus, $0.79, 25720 input / 5368 output. All four findings reviewed: correctness, regression risk, coverage, and cross-cutting checks (auth-bypass surface for roles-override, culture-pin timing, create-flow compatibility). Verdict: PASS on all. Output saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Added juser@acmecoffee.com to SeedData at deterministic position (between customer@ and retail-contacts loop -> AppUser.Id=11 on fresh seed). Added internal-org membership. Both Web and Api user-roles.json carry "11": ["User"] so UserSessionContextService.BuildAsync merges the baked-in User role into effective roles.

Replaced the Session 1 jdoe+roles=User override persona with a real-seeded "Jamie Ng — User" persona that uses juser email without override. Override path remains available in dev-quick-signin.js for future personas that cannot be DB-seeded.
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.infra.yml down -v wiped sqlserver volume, then up -d + app rebuild. Verified juser at Id=11 via SELECT Id, Email FROM AppUsers WHERE Id <= 14.

Replaced Session 1 shortcut test with SecurityNav_BakedInUserPersona_RealLoginFlow_NavVisibleRoleDocOnlyAsync. Drives: clear dev inbox, /login, fill email, Send sign-in link, open /dev/email-inbox in second Playwright page, scope to tbody tr.mud-table-row, assert href matches ^https?://.+/login\?token=, follow href on original page, assert Admin drawer + only Role Documentation tab.

Rewrote Item #1 of the UAT checklist as six steps that mirror the real-login test action-for-action. TestData carries literal CSS selectors + href pattern so a human tester follows identical operations.
dotnet test --filter !Playwright = 661/0. juser seed does not break any unit/integration/bUnit coverage.
Full Playwright suite: 127/0/1 green. Same count as Session 1 final because the real-login test replaced the scaffold test rather than adding alongside.

route(task_type=uat-coverage-review) VERIFIED on round 2. Round 1 flagged a Major issue (xUnit Assert.False on href not a Playwright assertion). Fix added ToHaveAttributeAsync regex check. Generator: opus, total $1.32. Verifier: gpt-5-4, total $0.25.

route(task_type=session-verification) PASS on all 4 review criteria: seed determinism, real-login test fidelity, regex strictness, separate-page state-leak analysis. Two minor observations noted (Id=11 magic number; regex token-first). Model: opus, $0.36.
